text:
lucy: quick heads-up: I hit a redaction regression in the node quickstart when changing log level at runtime. request IDs get stripped from structured JSON but still show up in formatted console output on retry lines.

omar: ugh. repro steps?

lucy: super small:
```
1) start quickstart with LOG_LEVEL=info and OTEL hook enabled
2) call admin endpoint to set LOG_LEVEL=debug at runtime
3) induce downstream 502 -> client retry emits logs
4) structured logs: reqId=null, console: 'retry attempt=2 reqId=req-X'
```

chen: that pattern usually means redaction runs on the serializer path but not on the final formatted message. which logger are you using?

lucy: pino v8 + our otel log hook. the retry helper logs inline: `logger.debug(`retry attempt=${i} reqId=${ctx.reqId}`)`. so reqId is embedded in the message string, bypassing structured fields. redaction currently only scrubs structured fields.

omar: can you paste the exact lines you saw?

lucy: ```
ERROR Downstream - request failed: 502 {"user":"u42","reqId":"req-X","err":"connreset"}
DEBUG Retry - retry attempt=2 reqId=req-X
{"ts":"...","level":"DEBUG","reqId":null}
```

chen: two independent issues: 1) inline token in message string, 2) redaction hook not applied to formatted console text especially after runtime-level swap where transports get reattached.

log-bot: Created INC-5012: runtime log-level swap -> console redaction bypass (assigned: devex).

omar: short-term mitigation: update retry wrapper to log reqId as metadata (logger.debug(msg, { reqId })) and push sample change. longer-term: make redaction operate on the final formatted string as a last-resort pass, or adopt a global pre-formatter hook so all output goes through redaction irrespective of transport.

lucy: I'll send a tiny PR to samples/node-quickstart that changes the retry helper and adds an integration test that toggles level at runtime and checks stdout. will also file a separate patch to reattach redaction transforms when transports are swapped.

chen: perf note: scanning every formatted string with heavy regex is expensive. if we add final-string redaction, do a cheap prefix/substring check for "req" or "reqId=" before running regex.

eng-qa: please include a matrix run in CI that covers runtime toggle scenario + bunyan/pino transports. QA will add a smoke test for python/go parity.

omar: parity note: python sdk already runs redaction in a pre-formatter hook and doesn't exhibit this gap. node and java are the ones to align. mark as sdk-parity + telemetry.

lucy: PR link: samples/node-quickstart#123 (draft) - includes failing test + fix. short-term recommended mitigation for customers: avoid inline tokens in logs; pass contextual ids as structured metadata so redaction works reliably.

chen: also check trace propagation: I saw a separate issue where traceparent was getting reset across retry due to context loss in retry wrapper. ensure we preserve active span when scheduling retry.

log-bot: Labels added to INC-5012: bug, telemetry, sdk-node, sdk-parity.

lucy: thanks all — will iterate on PR and follow up when CI green.
